claim: A body at rest remains at rest, and a body in uniform motion remains in uniform motion, unless acted upon by a net external force (Newton's First Law)

evidence.title: Newton's Principia Mathematica (SEP)
evidence.finding: Newton's first law defines inertial reference frames and establishes that force-free motion is uniform, confirmed by centuries of experiments

evidence.title: Galileo's Inclined Plane Experiments
evidence.finding: Galileo demonstrated that objects on frictionless planes maintain constant velocity, providing the empirical basis for inertia

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Directly verified in vacuum chambers, space missions (Voyager probes), and air-track experiments to extraordinary precision
scoreReasoning.coherence: Defines inertial frames which are the foundation for all of Newtonian and relativistic mechanics
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal agreement; Einstein's first postulate (special relativity) is a generalization of this principle
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Spacecraft navigation, vehicle design, and all mechanical engineering depend on inertia

claim: The acceleration of a body is directly proportional to the net force applied and inversely proportional to its mass: F = ma (Newton's Second Law)

evidence.title: Force and Motion: Newton's Second Law (AJP)
evidence.finding: F=ma has been verified across 40 orders of magnitude in force and mass, from subatomic particles to galactic dynamics

evidence.title: NIST SI Redefinition
evidence.finding: The 2019 SI redefinition anchors the kilogram to Planck's constant, relying on the precision of F=ma measurements

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Among the most precisely verified equations in physics — tested in every mechanics lab worldwide
scoreReasoning.coherence: Central equation of all Newtonian mechanics; connects force, mass, and acceleration in a single framework
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal agreement at macroscopic scales; superseded by relativistic and quantum formulations at extremes
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Every rocket, bridge, vehicle, and machine is designed using F=ma

claim: For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction — forces always occur in equal and opposite pairs (Newton's Third Law)

evidence.title: Newton's Principia — Third Law (SEP)
evidence.finding: Newton's third law implies conservation of momentum, verified in every collision experiment and rocket propulsion

evidence.title: Understanding Newton's Third Law (AJP)
evidence.finding: Direct force measurements on interacting bodies consistently confirm equal and opposite force pairs to experimental precision

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Directly measured using force sensors on interacting bodies; rocket propulsion provides dramatic confirmation
scoreReasoning.coherence: Implies conservation of momentum; foundational to all collision physics and fluid dynamics
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal agreement; some subtleties with electromagnetic forces but overall principle holds
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Rocket propulsion, structural engineering, and biomechanics all depend on the third law

claim: Every mass attracts every other mass with a force proportional to the product of their masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them

evidence.title: Experiments to Determine the Density of the Earth (Cavendish 1798)
evidence.finding: Cavendish directly measured the gravitational constant G using a torsion balance, confirming the inverse-square law between masses

evidence.title: Measurement of Newton's Constant Using a Torsion Balance (Gundlach 2000)
evidence.finding: Modern measurements of G agree to 5 significant figures, confirming Newton's gravitational law at laboratory scales

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Directly measured by Cavendish experiment and successors; confirmed by planetary orbits, tides, and satellite trajectories
scoreReasoning.coherence: Superseded by general relativity for strong fields but remains exact in the weak-field limit
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal agreement on the inverse-square law; G itself is the least precisely known fundamental constant
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Satellite orbits, tidal predictions, and spacecraft navigation all use Newtonian gravity

claim: Emmy Noether proved that every continuous symmetry of a physical system's action corresponds to a conserved quantity — time symmetry yields energy conservation, spatial symmetry yields momentum conservation

evidence.title: Invariante Variationsprobleme (Noether 1918)
evidence.finding: Noether's theorem is a rigorous mathematical proof: continuous symmetry implies conserved current. Time invariance → energy conservation, translation invariance → momentum conservation

evidence.title: The Real Emmy Noether (Physics Today)
evidence.finding: Noether's theorem is considered one of the most important results in theoretical physics, unifying symmetry and conservation

scoreReasoning.correspondence: The theorem is a mathematical proof; its physical predictions (conservation laws) are verified to extreme precision in particle physics
scoreReasoning.coherence: Unifies symmetry and conservation — one of the deepest structural results in physics
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universally accepted in theoretical physics; no serious challenge exists
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Guides the construction of all modern physical theories; conservation laws are the most powerful tools in physics

claim: Planetary and satellite orbits follow precisely from Newton's laws of motion and gravitation, as confirmed by Kepler's laws and modern spaceflight

evidence.title: Newton's Derivation of Kepler's Laws (SEP)
evidence.finding: Newton proved that an inverse-square central force produces elliptical orbits with the force center at one focus, exactly Kepler's laws

evidence.title: Voyager Navigation (AIAA)
evidence.finding: Voyager spacecraft navigated the outer solar system using Newtonian orbital mechanics with relativistic corrections, arriving within meters of predicted trajectories

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Spacecraft navigate billions of kilometers using these equations and arrive within meters of predictions
scoreReasoning.coherence: Direct mathematical consequence of Newton's laws; beautifully confirms the entire framework
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal agreement; general relativistic corrections needed only for extreme precision (Mercury's perihelion)
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: All satellite operations, GPS, space missions, and planetary science depend on orbital mechanics

claim: Newton's laws of motion and universal gravitation accurately describe macroscopic physical interactions at non-relativistic speeds

evidence.title: Newton's Principia (SEP)
evidence.finding: Newton's Principia remains the foundation of classical physics 340 years later, applicable across most engineering and everyday physics

evidence.title: Teaching Newton's Laws (AJP)
evidence.finding: Classical mechanics correctly predicts the behavior of everything from projectiles to planetary orbits within its domain of validity

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Verified across 300+ years of experiments; domain of validity (low speed, weak gravity, large scale) is well-characterized
scoreReasoning.coherence: Self-consistent mathematical framework; known limits (relativity, quantum) are understood, not contradictions
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal agreement on validity within its domain; superseded only at extreme scales
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: The vast majority of engineering, from bridges to rockets, uses Newton's laws
